text:
Done — I refreshed the UI and split the code into smaller pieces without changing the app’s behavior.

What I changed:
- Gave the app a more modern look:
  - softer gradient background
  - glassy/sticky top bar
  - rounded cards and buttons
  - improved spacing, focus states, and mobile layout
- Tidied up the frontend structure:
  - moved shared helpers into `public/common.js`
  - simplified the page files a bit by keeping the shared logic centralized
- Split out repeated backend logic:
  - added `src/utils.js` for shared ID parsing
  - updated route files to use it
  - kept the existing API behavior the same

Files touched:
- `public/styles.css`
- `public/common.js`
- `public/index.html`
- `public/login.html`
- `public/signup.html`
- `public/post.html`
- `public/profile.html`
- `src/server.js`
- `src/utils.js`
- `src/routes/posts.js`
- `src/routes/comments.js`
- `src/routes/users.js`

I also sanity-checked the updated server and route files for syntax errors.
